mapper.select: SELECT dt.trade_id AS tradeId, dt.general_customer_id AS generalCustomerId, dt.trade_type AS tradeType, dt.stock_code AS stockCode, dt.qty AS qty, dt.price AS price, dt.executed_at AS executedAt FROM domestic_trade dt JOIN general_customer gc ON gc.general_customer_id = dt.general_customer_id WHERE gc.ci_hash = #{ciHash} ORDER BY dt.executed_at DESC, dt.trade_id DESC
SELECT general_customer_id FROM general_customer WHERE ci_hash = #{ciHash}
SELECT DISTINCT gc.general_customer_id, gc.ci_hash FROM domestic_trade dt JOIN general_customer gc ON gc.general_customer_id = dt.general_customer_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO domestic_trade (general_customer_id, trade_type, stock_code, qty, price, executed_at, maria_order_id) VALUES (#{generalCustomerId}, #{tradeType}, #{stockCode}, #{qty}, #{price}, #{executedAt}, #{mariaOrderId})
